body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Email Sent from Saleshandy trigger (Zoho) on Production, all 5 activities, 8 checks:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Create/Update a Lead in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho: one lead created with the mapped Lead Fields and the prospect company, and one note. | Pass |
| 2 | Create/Update a Contact in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho: one contact created with the mapped Contact Fields. | Pass |
| 3 | Create/Update a Contact in Zoho | Existing contact with an old Phone and Title: the same contact is updated and no second contact is made. | Pass |
| 4 | Create/Update Account in Zoho | Prospect with a company and no contact: account created with the company name and the mapped Account Fields, not linked to a contact. | Pass |
| 5 | Create/Update a Deal in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho, Closing date 0: one deal created with the Deal Value as Amount and an empty Closing Date. | Pass |
| 6 | Create a Task in Zoho | Contact created, then one task linked to it with the configured Subject, Status, Priority and the due date set 3 days ahead. | Pass |
| 7 | Create/Update a Contact and Create/Update a Lead together | One contact and one lead created, no duplicate contact. | Pass |
| 8 | Trigger turned off | Email sent with the trigger off: nothing created or changed in Zoho. | Pass |
waitingFor: QA to review wording and send via npm run jira.
